exposure: prior vaginal delivery prior to the CS
cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies and a prior single low transverse cesarean section (CS) who attempted vaginal delivery in a tertiary hospital (2010-2014)
finding: Previous VBAC, prior vaginal delivery prior to CS, and shorter interval from prior CS were predictive of successful VBAC, while induction of labor was associated with a lower likelihood of VBAC.
birth_weight: Not specified for the whole cohort, but analyzed as a predictor for VBAC in women with no prior vaginal birth.
